subject: NimbleStore renewal & term-swap: accelerated capacity offer
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-06-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NimbleStore renewal — prepare a rapid save plan and benchmark pack

Team,

Heads-up: NimbleStore's renewal (Q3) just surfaced as at-risk — they received a price/perf push from a competitor and have asked for a formal comparison. I spoke with Sarah briefly yesterday; they want a concrete capacity uplift option + term flexibility by COB Wed.

Ask: can we prepare (1) an apples-to-apples throughput/latency benchmark against the competitor's config, (2) a cost delta spreadsheet showing committed vs on-demand, and (3) a proposed term-swap (12 months) with a 3-month ramp and priority routing?

Marissa — please draft the save offer (discount + dedicated capacity + SLA). Karthik — can you validate whether the requested QoS is achievable with a dedicated pool and provide expected token latency at 95th percentile.

Attachments to include in our outbound: benchmarking framework, historical consumption, SOC2 snapshot.

I'll lead the customer call once we have the numbers.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Oliver Barnes <oliver@nimblestore.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah@nimblestore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-06-03T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Quick call + benchmark pack — NimbleStore renewal

Oliver / Sarah,

Thanks for the candid note earlier. I wanted to share a short benchmark pack we ran with a configuration that matches the competitor's spec and propose a call to walk the results through.

Attached: benchmark_report_Q2_2028.pdf (throughput & tail latency), cost_comparison_nimble.xlsx (committed vs competitor), SOC2_snapshot_2028.zip.

Proposed call times: Thurs 6/6 10:00–11:00 PT or 4:00–4:30 PT. If you prefer, we can do a short screen share of the trial results and then propose a term/commitment that addresses cost and performance.

Goal: make sure you have a defensible, measurable reason to stay on Redwood — and a clear path for the capacity increase you asked about.

Regards,
Vivek

From: Oliver Barnes <oliver@nimblestore.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah@nimblestore.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick call + benchmark pack — NimbleStore renewal

Vivek,

Appreciate the materials. Quick summary from our side: the competitor (NimbusAI) has offered a package with a 15% price advantage on committed tokens, a hard SLA on P95 latency (350ms) during peak windows, and a migration credit if we sign before June 20. They also provided a live side-by-side trial.

Our leadership is pressing for both the price delta and a performance guarantee. We need to see an offer that includes an uplift to ~2x current capacity during promotional months and a commitment window tied to price protection.

I'll take the call on Thursday 6/6 at 10:00 PT.

Oliver
Director of ML Engineering
NimbleStore

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Cc: Oliver Barnes <oliver@nimblestore.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah@nimblestore.com>
Date: 2028-06-05T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick call + benchmark pack — NimbleStore renewal (draft save offer)

Oliver / Sarah — following our internal run and the notes from Vivek, here's a concise save plan we can share on the call. I'm sending the formal PDF as an attachment (save_offer_terms.pdf).

Summary (proposal):
- Term swap: 12-month committed term (prices fixed for 12 months).
- Capacity uplift: Dedicated pool to support a 2x peak uplift for months 1–3, then 1.25x baseline thereafter.
- Pricing: 12% discount off standard committed tier (plus a one-time 10% credit on month 1 usage to offset migration overhead).
- SLA & routing: P95 latency SLA of 360ms for the committed workload profile; priority routing and pre-warmed instances during announced promos.
- Operational commitments: 24/7 onboarding support, weekly triage calls during the ramp window, and a performance regression alerting hook into your PagerDuty.

Attachments included: save_offer_terms.pdf (term language + breakout), cost_comparison_nimble.xlsx (updated with committed pricing), benchmark_report_Q2_2028.pdf (annotated).

Notes on risk: the SLA is achievable with dedicated capacity and prefix/KV caching we plan to enable. Karthik — please confirm the P95 number below as an output we can guarantee with the dedicated pool and the stated work profile.

If this aligns, we can route a DocuSign term-swap link during/after the call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Oliver Barnes <oliver@nimblestore.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah@nimblestore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-06-06T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick call + benchmark pack — NimbleStore renewal (final offer)

Oliver / Sarah,

Thanks for the call today — appreciated the transparency. To summarize the offer Redwood is prepared to move on immediately to keep your workload stable and performant:

1) Contract: 12-month committed term (term-swap) with price protection.
2) Capacity: Dedicated pool sized to support 2x peak for months 1–3; operational runbook and weekly check-ins during ramp.
3) Commercial: 10% one-time usage credit on month 1 + 12% committed discount thereafter.
4) SLA: P95 latency guarantee of 360ms for the specified profile; automatic fallback to the nearest compatible model variant with warm standby if SLA is breached.
5) Compliance & evidence: SOC2 snapshot attached; we will provide audit logs for the first 90 days as part of the onboarding package.

Next step: sign the term-swap DocuSign (link below) to lock in pricing and capacity — once executed, engineering will begin the dedicated pool provisioning and an onboarding kickoff within 48 hours.

DocuSign (term-swap): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/DocuSign-NS-TermSwap-202806

Attachments: save_offer_terms.pdf, benchmark_report_Q2_2028.pdf, cost_comparison_nimble.xlsx

If you want any adjustments (shorter ramp, different credit structure), we can iterate quickly — but we wanted to get this into your hands before Nimbus' June 20 deadline.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
